Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee cannot stand, and it is returned to the rider in full. Why. Under POL-NS-01 a no-show fee is chargeable only if all four conditions hold. The first three are satisfied on the driver's own evidence: the trip record (EV-TRIP-02747) carries the driver's 'I'm Here' event at 11:22:26, and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02747) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius of the Serangoon Ave 3 pin from 11:22:26 to 11:28:46 — 380 continuous seconds across 39 qualifying fixes, minimum distance to the pin 0.0 m — so limb (b) and the 180-second free-waiting dwell in limb (c) (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec) are met, and the marker is not a false one (POL-NS-05 is not engaged: no marker more than 300 m out, no motion at or above 15 km/h). Condition (d) fails. The trip was terminated by the driver at 11:28:47 under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, and POL-NS-01 states in terms that this code is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d); the driver's own statement of 9 Sep ('Could not locate the rider so I cancelled') confirms it, and the driver's brief concedes the point. Because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, POL-NS-01 fixes the outcome itself: the fee is not chargeable, the ruling is FULL_REFUND, and no driver compensation is payable. Amount. The only charge on the ledger (EV-FARE-02747) is the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 (total_charged 4.50; payment_status CHARGED; refund_issued_sgd 0.00); it reconciles with the net figure in force (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and nothing beyond that line can be ordered. The full SGD 4.50 is returned. The monetary effect is SGD 4.50, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund executes automatically. Driver compensation is nil. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; limb (d) fails, so there is no payout. The anti-farming check does not trip in any event: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the four-or-more limb, and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 138 is 0.0145, below the 0.08 rate limb. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and no impaired artifact carries a deciding fact. Claims answered. The driver's claims that POL-NS-02 arrival is made out, that the marker is not false under POL-NS-05, and that the 380-second dwell exceeds the free waiting period so POL-NS-06 yields no refund on shortfall grounds are accepted — they are correct and I rely on the trace for exactly those facts — but they do not change the result, because limb (d) independently fails, which the driver's own final claim also concedes. The rider's POL-NS-04 claim (locating message 'at the lift lobby' at 11:23:26 unanswered within 120 s, no in-app call, rider device 13.1–19.1 m from the pin across 65 fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius) is also made out on EV-CHAT-02747 and EV-GPS-02747, but it is not needed: the refund follows from POL-NS-01 alone. The rider's claims that POL-NS-03 pin-ambiguity goodwill does not arise (correct — the qualifying fixes lie inside the radius, so the wrong-entrance route is not reached), that the contested sum is SGD 4.50, and that no artifact is impaired are accepted. Impaired or absent evidence. EV-ADVIS-02747-01 (traffic advisory) is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; it carries no fact and is not needed, because the driver's dwell was one continuous in-geofence interval, so POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation rule — the only limb that requires an advisory — never comes into play. All other artifacts (trip record, GPS trace, chat log, fare ledger and both profiles) are COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence in this ruling is not capped below 1.0.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.50 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Draft 1 - sampled
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee cannot stand, and it is returned to the rider in full. Why. Under POL-NS-01 a no-show fee is chargeable only if all four conditions hold. The first three are satisfied on the driver's own evidence: the trip record (EV-TRIP-02747) carries the driver's 'I'm Here' event at 11:22:26, and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02747) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius of the Serangoon Ave 3 pin from 11:22:26 to 11:28:46 — 380 continuous seconds across 39 qualifying fixes, minimum distance to the pin 0.0 m — so limb (b) and the 180-second free-waiting dwell in limb (c) (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec) are met, and the marker is not a false one (POL-NS-05 is not engaged: no marker more than 300 m out, no motion at or above 15 km/h). Condition (d) fails. The trip was terminated by the driver at 11:28:47 under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, and POL-NS-01 states in terms that this code is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d); the driver's own statement of 9 Sep ('Could not locate the rider so I cancelled') confirms it, and the driver's brief concedes the point. Because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, POL-NS-01 fixes the outcome itself: the fee is not chargeable, the ruling is FULL_REFUND, and no driver compensation is payable. Amount. The only charge on the ledger (EV-FARE-02747) is the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 (total_charged 4.50; payment_status CHARGED; refund_issued_sgd 0.00); it reconciles with the net figure in force (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and nothing beyond that line can be ordered. The full SGD 4.50 is returned. The monetary effect is SGD 4.50, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund executes automatically. Driver compensation is nil. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; limb (d) fails, so there is no payout. The anti-farming check does not trip in any event: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the four-or-more limb, and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 138 is 0.0145, below the 0.08 rate limb. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and no impaired artifact carries a deciding fact. Claims answered. The driver's claims that POL-NS-02 arrival is made out, that the marker is not false under POL-NS-05, and that the 380-second dwell exceeds the free waiting period so POL-NS-06 yields no refund on shortfall grounds are accepted — they are correct and I rely on the trace for exactly those facts — but they do not change the result, because limb (d) independently fails, which the driver's own final claim also concedes. The rider's POL-NS-04 claim (locating message 'at the lift lobby' at 11:23:26 unanswered within 120 s, no in-app call, rider device 13.1–19.1 m from the pin across 65 fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius) is also made out on EV-CHAT-02747 and EV-GPS-02747, but it is not needed: the refund follows from POL-NS-01 alone. The rider's claims that POL-NS-03 pin-ambiguity goodwill does not arise (correct — the qualifying fixes lie inside the radius, so the wrong-entrance route is not reached), that the contested sum is SGD 4.50, and that no artifact is impaired are accepted. Impaired or absent evidence. EV-ADVIS-02747-01 (traffic advisory) is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; it carries no fact and is not needed, because the driver's dwell was one continuous in-geofence interval, so POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation rule — the only limb that requires an advisory — never comes into play. All other artifacts (trip record, GPS trace, chat log, fare ledger and both profiles) are COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence in this ruling is not capped below 1.0.

Why the fee still fails. This trip was terminated by the driver under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE (EV-TRIP-02747), which the clause itself states is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). Draft 4 - parties' positions swapped
Rider, your claim is upheld; Driver, the no-show fee cannot stand on this record. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only where all four of its conditions hold together, and condition (d) requires the trip to have been terminated by the driver under RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. The trip record EV-TRIP-02747 shows the trip cancelled by the driver at 11:28:47 under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, and the driver's own statement ('Could not locate the rider so I cancelled') confirms it; POL-NS-01 states in terms that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). With limb (d) failed the fee is not chargeable, and the surrounding facts put this squarely in the branch POL-NS-01 fixes for a wrong reason code: the GPS trace EV-GPS-02747 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius continuously for 380 seconds (39 qualifying fixes, 11:22:26 to 11:28:46). So the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the mis-selected reason code goes into the referrals as a driver-education item. The rider independently succeeds under POL-NS-04: she sent a locating message ('at the lift lobby') at 11:23:26 inside the waiting window, the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds and placed no in-app call, and her device sat 13.1-19.1 m from the pin across all 65 fixes, well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius; that clause also refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation. On the driver's claims: I accept the POL-NS-02 proximity test is met (39 consecutive in-radius fixes, minimum distance 0.0 m), that POL-NS-05 cannot mark the arrival false (the 11:22:26 marker already places him inside the geofence and stationary, far inside the 300 m ceiling and the 15 km/h threshold, so the waiting clock is not recomputed and no false-arrival referral arises), and that POL-NS-06 gives the rider no shortfall route - the 380-second dwell exceeds the 180-second free waiting period in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, the derived shortfall being -200 seconds, a surplus. Those findings do not save the fee, because limb (d) fails independently. I also accept there is no POL-NS-07 anti-farming pattern (no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below four, and 2/138 = 0.0145, below 0.08) and that the fare ledger reconciles with the SGD 4.50 net figure in force under POL-NS-08(d) - but POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not, so the driver receives nothing; the driver conceded this correctly. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02747-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no fact here: the dwell is one continuous in-geofence interval, so no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is needed and its absence neither defeats nor supports the refund. The deciding facts rest on EV-TRIP-02747 and EV-GPS-02747, both COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is not capped and stands at 0.9; no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is engaged. The rider's claim that cites the missing advisory without naming its issue code is discarded as the referee recorded. The refund of SGD 4.50 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05 and executes automatically.
